title: Serial Chatbot
intro: No wiring needed! Write a chatbot that talks to you in the Serial Monitor.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.text:
The board can talk to your laptop over the USB cable. That's called **serial**.

- `Serial.begin(9600);` starts talking, at 9600 bits each second.
- `Serial.println("...");` sends a line of text. Text always goes inside `" "`.

**Your task:** fill in the blank with a hello message of your own, then press **Run** and look at the **Serial Monitor**.
hints: The line can be `Serial.println("Hello! I'm your Arduino.");`

checks.label: The Serial Monitor shows your message

steps.success: Your board said hello! Serial is how you'll find out what your code is doing.

steps.title: Count
steps.text:
A **variable** is a named box that holds a value. `int count = 0;` makes a box called `count` holding 0.

**Your task:** fill in the blank so the board counts 1, 2, 3... one number each second.
hints: How much bigger should the number get each time?
steps.success: Counting! `count = count + 1` is so common it has a shortcut: `count++`.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text:
Now the board listens. `Serial.available()` says how many letters are waiting. `Serial.readStringUntil('\n')` reads them up to the end of the line (when you press Enter), into a **String**.

**Your task:** finish the code so the board repeats what you type, like `You said: hello`. Type in the Serial Monitor's box and press Enter.
hints: `Serial.print` stays on the same line; `Serial.println` ends the line.
Print the `message` variable, without quote marks.

checks.label: The board repeats what you typed

steps.success: Your board is listening! In the simulator, the Serial Monitor typed "hi" to test it.

steps.title: ChatBot
steps.text:
**Goal:** a chatbot. When you type `hello` it says hello back. `how are you` and `joke` get their own answers. Anything else gets "I don't understand that yet".

Use `if`, `else if` and `else` to choose an answer. `message.toLowerCase();` makes HELLO and Hello the same as hello.
hints: Chain the questions: `if (...) { } else if (...) { } else { }`.
Use **Watch the goal** to see one way to do it.

checks.label: It says when it doesn't understand

steps.success: You built a chatbot with no AI at all: just your own rules. Add more answers to make it smarter!

outro: You built a chatbot from scratch. It uses **Serial** to talk, a **String** to remember what you typed, and **if / else if** to choose an answer. (And no AI!)
stretch: Ask for the person's name, remember it in a String, and use it in later answers.
Make a guess-the-number game: the board picks a random number and says "higher" or "lower".
Answer "time" with how many seconds the board has been on (`millis() / 1000`).
